verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a broad Dynadot API covering registration, transfer, renewal, aftermarket and reseller management. Nothing in the pack shows an endpoint or feed that returns current registration, renewal or transfer prices per TLD. The reseller line about setting customer-facing prices is an adjacent control, not a machine-readable price list, and no OpenAPI spec was found.

support.subject: As a developer, pricing is machine-readable — an API or feed returns current registration/renewal/transfer prices per TLD so tooling can compare and budget
